programmes.funder: GSMA / Fira de Barcelona
programmes.amount_note: Winner receives an exhibition and networking package at MWC Barcelona. No large cash purse.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications open in the autumn and close in the winter ahead of MWC Barcelona in late February or early March
programmes.reopen_note: Runs annually with MWC Barcelona. Applications typically open in the autumn.

programmes.funder: ACCIÓ (Generalitat de Catalunya)
programmes.amount_note: Vouchers co-funding innovation, technology and internationalisation services from accredited providers; value set per voucher type.

programmes.funder: ACCIÓ – Agència per a la Competitivitat de l'Empresa (Generalitat de Catalunya)
programmes.amount_note: Grant commonly of up to EUR 100,000 for technology-based startups in Catalonia; confirm the ceiling in the current convocatòria.

programmes.funder: Centro para el Desarrollo Tecnológico y la Innovación (CDTI Innovación)
programmes.amount_note: Partially repayable aid for R&D projects in the Cervera priority technologies, with a higher non-repayable tranche than standard PID.

programmes.name_en: CDTI NEOTEC programme – grants for new technology-based companies
programmes.funder: Centro para el Desarrollo Tecnológico y la Innovación (CDTI Innovación), Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades
programmes.amount_note: 'Subvenciones hasta el 70% del presupuesto elegible' with an 'importe máximo de subvención de 250.000 euros por beneficiario', rising to 85% coverage and up to EUR 325,000 where the company hires doctorate holders. The 2026 call budget is EUR 20,383,300, of which EUR 5,000,000 is reserved for projects led by women.
programmes.deadline_note: 2026 call: 'Del 14 de abril hasta el 14 de mayo de 2026, a las 12:00 horas'. NEOTEC is run as an annual call.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm eligibility: innovative company with a maximum of three years since incorporation and minimum share capital of EUR 20,000.
Prepare the business plan for the new technology-based company and the eligible budget.
Submit the application electronically through the CDTI portal within the call window.
Competitive evaluation; the resolution and the call terms are published in the BOE.

documents_required.doc: Escritura de constitución evidencing company age and share capital of at least EUR 20,000

documents_required.note: Only if claiming the enhanced 85% rate / EUR 325,000 ceiling

eligibility.other_note: 'Tres años de antigüedad máximo'; 'Capital social mínimo: 20.000 euros'. The call is framed under Reglamento (UE) 651/2014 (general block exemption) rather than de minimis, per the CDTI page; a de minimis basis is therefore not asserted here.

programmes.source_snippet: Subvenciones hasta el 70% del presupuesto elegible ... importe máximo de subvención de 250.000 euros por beneficiario ... Tres años de antigüedad máximo ... Capital social mínimo: 20.000 euros ... Del 14 de abril hasta el 14 de mayo de 2026, a las 12:00 horas.

programmes.funder: Centro para el Desarrollo Tecnológico y la Innovación (CDTI Innovación)
programmes.amount_note: Grant of up to EUR 250,000 per beneficiary (70% of eligible budget), rising to EUR 325,000 and 85% coverage if the project includes hiring at least one PhD holder. Additional increments of EUR 18,300 (MIT) or EUR 10,000 (GeorgiaTech) for qualifying training. Total 2026 budget EUR 20,383,300, with at least EUR 5,000,000 reserved for women-led projects.
programmes.deadline_note: 2026 call open 14 April – 14 May 2026 at 12:00 (Spanish time).
programmes.reopen_note: NEOTEC has been run as an annual call by CDTI for many years, typically opening in spring; a 2027 call is expected on a similar cycle.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the company in the CDTI electronic office (sede.cdti.gob.es)
Complete the NEOTEC memoria técnica and budget
Submit with qualified electronic signature before the closing time
Evaluation and resolution published by CDTI

eligibility.other_note: Small innovative company with a maximum of three years of activity and minimum share capital of EUR 20,000. Technology must be the company's competitive differentiator; service-resale business models without proprietary technology are not eligible.

programmes.source_snippet: Apoyar la creación de empresas de base tecnológica con vocación de crecimiento. La tecnología debe ser el factor competitivo de diferenciación de la empresa.

programmes.funder: Centro para el Desarrollo Tecnológico y la Innovación (CDTI Innovación)
programmes.amount_note: Partially repayable aid (ayuda parcialmente reembolsable) covering up to 75-85% of the project budget, with a non-repayable tranche. Minimum project budget applies.

programmes.name_en: CDTI R&D Projects (PID) – partially repayable aid
programmes.funder: Centro para el Desarrollo Tecnológico y la Innovación (CDTI Innovación)
programmes.amount_note: 'Ayuda parcialmente reembolsable' covering up to 85% of the approved budget, with the company contributing at least 15% of its own resources. Minimum eligible project budget of EUR 175,000. No published maximum on the page.
programmes.deadline_note: 'Convocatoria abierta todo el año' — applications can be submitted continuously throughout the year.

procedure_steps.detail: Scope an industrial research or experimental development project with a budget of at least EUR 175,000 (individual, or a consortium of 2-6 autonomous companies for cooperative projects).
Submit the project memoria and budget through the CDTI electronic portal at any time of year.
CDTI technical and economic-financial evaluation; on approval the partially repayable aid is contracted and disbursed against milestones.

documents_required.doc: Memoria técnica del proyecto (technical project report)
Cuentas anuales / financial statements demonstrating solvency

eligibility.other_note: Beneficiaries are companies of any size with legal personality in Spain; the company must contribute at least 15% of the project cost from its own resources.

programmes.source_snippet: Ayuda parcialmente reembolsable ... Convocatoria abierta todo el año ... presupuesto mínimo 175.000 euros.

programmes.funder: COFIDES / Ministerio para la Transformación Digital
programmes.amount_note: Public-private fund of funds and co-investment vehicle for digital scaleups and deeptech; ticket size set per investment.

programmes.funder: Empresa Nacional de Innovación S.M.E., S.A. (ENISA)
programmes.amount_note: Participative loan for digital and technology companies, commonly up to EUR 1,500,000 in the higher lines. Amount is capped by the company's own funds.

programmes.funder: Empresa Nacional de Innovación S.M.E., S.A. (ENISA)
programmes.amount_note: Participative loan commonly from EUR 25,000 to EUR 75,000 for companies whose majority shareholders are under 40. Confirm the current ceiling in the open convocatoria.

eligibility.other_note: ENISA participative loans require no personal guarantees; interest is partly linked to company performance. ENISA lines are opened by annual convocatoria with a budget that is exhausted during the year.

programmes.name_en: ENISA participative loans for SMEs and startups
programmes.funder: Empresa Nacional de Innovación S.A. (ENISA), Ministerio de Industria y Turismo
programmes.amount_note: 'Préstamos de 25.000 a 1.500.000 euros' as participative loans ('préstamo participativo'), 'Sin garantías' (no personal guarantees) and 'Los primeros 2 años, sólo pagas intereses'. Specialised lines exist: Innovación x Clima, Emprendedoras Digitales (women-led tech SMEs), AgroInnpulso, and Audiovisual e Industrias Culturales y Creativas.
programmes.deadline_note: 'Convocatoria abierta' — the call is open and applications are submitted continuously through the ENISA client portal while budget lasts.

procedure_steps.detail: Choose the line that matches your company (general or one of the specialised lines).
Register in the ENISA client portal and submit the application with the business plan and financials.
ENISA analyses the project and the team; if approved, the participative loan is formalised with a 2-year interest-only period.

documents_required.doc: Audited or filed annual accounts / financial projections
Escritura de constitución and company registration documents

eligibility.other_note: Spanish SMEs. No personal guarantees are required — 'Tu proyecto y talento' act as collateral. Exact age/size conditions differ per line and are set out in each line's page.

programmes.source_snippet: Préstamos de 25.000 a 1.500.000 euros ... Los primeros 2 años, sólo pagas intereses ... Sin garantías ... Convocatoria abierta.

programmes.name_local: ESA BIC Spain (Barcelona, Madrid and Comunitat Valenciana)
programmes.funder: European Space Agency (ESA) with the national space agency or regional co-funder
programmes.amount_note: EUR 50,000 equity-free funding for product and IP development, plus up to two years of incubation with technical support from ESA experts, business coaching, legal and IPR advice and fundraising support. Some national BICs add local top-up funding.
programmes.deadline_note: This ESA BIC runs its own call cycle with published cut-off dates, typically two to four per year. Contact the local centre for the next deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the local ESA BIC to discuss suitability
Submit application documents before the local deadline
Tender Opening Board review, then presentation to the Tender Evaluation Board
Register a company in Spain before signing the incubation contract

eligibility.other_note: Business must use space-based systems, apply space technology in a non-space domain, or develop products and services for the space sector. Company must be registered in Spain.

programmes.source_snippet: €50k equity free funding for product and IP development

programmes.funder: Instituto Galego de Promoción Económica (IGAPE)
programmes.amount_note: Regional grants for innovative business projects and industrial investment in Galicia; ceilings set per annual call.

programmes.name_local: Programa de subvenciones a la I+D+i de Andalucía (Agencia IDEA)
programmes.funder: Agencia de Innovación y Desarrollo de Andalucía (IDEA) / TRADE
programmes.amount_note: Incentives for business creation, innovation and digitalisation in Andalusia; aid intensity depends on the line and company size.

programmes.funder: IVACE+i (Institut Valencià de Competitivitat i Innovació)
programmes.amount_note: Annual convocatorias for SME innovation, industrial R&D and digitalisation projects in the Valencian Community; ceilings set per line.

programmes.name_local: Ayudas a la innovación de PYMES de la Comunidad de Madrid
programmes.name_en: Community of Madrid SME innovation aid
programmes.funder: Comunidad de Madrid
programmes.amount_note: Regional grants for SME innovation and technology projects; ceilings set in each annual convocatoria published in the BOCM.

programmes.funder: Red.es / Ministerio para la Transformación Digital
programmes.amount_note: Digital bonus (bono digital) whose value depends on the company's headcount segment; spent with registered digitalisation agents on catalogue solutions.
programmes.reopen_note: Kit Digital segments have opened and closed at different times as budget is committed; check acelerapyme.gob.es for the segments currently open.

programmes.funder: SPRI – Agencia Vasca de Desarrollo Empresarial
programmes.amount_note: Open innovation acceleration programme matching startups with Basque industrial corporates; provides pilot contracts and support rather than a fixed grant.

programmes.funder: SPRI – Agencia Vasca de Desarrollo Empresarial / Gobierno Vasco
programmes.amount_note: Grants for competitive and strategic industrial R&D projects by Basque companies; aid intensity set per call and research category.
